title: build.gate cannot tell a real recompile from a cache-restored or up-to-date Gradle compile
wanted_capability: build.gate should disclose whether the compile tasks it gated actually executed. For Gradle, parse task outcomes (FROM-CACHE, UP-TO-DATE, executed) and report them, so a gate run right after source edits that did not recompile the edited sources is flagged rather than treated as a pass; the recipe guidance should name a cache-bypassing mode for post-edit gates.
missing_primitive: build.gate task-outcome reporting (recompiled vs restored) for Gradle
fallback_used: The probe reran validation after a later hygiene/change path exposed the generated-source issue; final compile passed after repair.
evidence: crates/bro-harness/src/bindings/build_gate.rs (parse_build_output, detect_tool: Gradle output reduced to javac diagnostics and status lines; no task-outcome field in BuildGateResult)
notes: Generic finding from a private Java probe. The first post-extract compile appeared successful from cache even though the generated helper signature still contained an invalid parameter type. The recipe should not treat cached compile output as sufficient evidence after source edits.
